note: PMID 29379197 corresponds to the primary study by Olley et al. (2018) identifying BRD4 variants in Cornelia de Lange-like syndrome, for which an amendment was later published.

evidence.text: The primary paper indexed under PMID 29379197 by Olley et al. (2018) reports that BRD4 haploinsufficiency causes a phenotype overlapping Cornelia de Lange syndrome, and notes that an amendment was published.
